titles.how: Opened a ledger during the closed beta

titles.name: Monster Botherer
titles.how: Beat every boss at least once

recipes.name: Fish supper
recipes.text: Three fish, fried. Gives back 15 energy for training.

recipes.name: Raid feast
recipes.text: A proper spread. Gives one raid ticket.

recipes.name: Strip for parts
recipes.text: Five bits of junk become one spare part. Parts go into gear upgrades.

recipes.name: Fine parts
recipes.text: Two spare treasures become three parts.

recipes.name: Restore a relic
recipes.text: Six bits of junk and 30 gold, cleaned up into a cabinet piece you are missing.

recipes.name: Piece a card together
recipes.text: Four spare treasures and 150 gold become one card shard.

tonics.name: Quickstep Tonic
tonics.text: Every job runs 25% faster for an hour.

tonics.name: Lucky Dip Tonic
tonics.text: Better finds everywhere for an hour.

tonics.name: Bookworm Tonic
tonics.text: Half again as much skill xp for an hour.

potions.name: Healing Draught
potions.text: Drunk mid-fight, it gives the team back a third of its health.

potions.name: Ironskin Draught
potions.text: The next three hits the team takes do half damage.

potions.name: Fury Draught
potions.text: The team's next three blows land 60% harder.

bosses.name: The Tiber Thing
bosses.text: Nobody has seen all of it. The part with the teeth is enough.

bosses.name: Big Tony's Boys
bosses.text: Four gentlemen who would like a word about the safe.

bosses.name: The Emu Vanguard
bosses.text: They beat an army once. They would like to do it again.

bosses.name: Gary the Great White
bosses.text: He is between the flags. That is the problem.

bosses.name: The Doge's Nephew
bosses.text: Bad at guarding. Surprisingly good at fencing.

bosses.name: The Thing Under the Well
bosses.text: It was buried for a reason. Smudge had a shovel.

bosses.name: The Antlered Deep
bosses.text: Something under the ice has antlers. It also has opinions.

bosses.name: Brenda, Back From Leave
bosses.text: She has seen the state of the supply closet.

heroes.name: Kevin Latham
heroes.title: Office Worker
heroes.bio: Kevin has been 'circling back' on the same email since March. He was summoned mid-sip and has not put the mug down since. Nobody at his office has noticed he is gone.
heroes.fact: Sloths move so little that algae grows in their fur and turns them slightly green.
lines: Kevin from the office! He brought his coffee!
Kevin. From accounting. Somehow still on break.
It's fucking Kevin. With his mug. Nobody asked for Kevin.

heroes.name: Marco Reyes
heroes.title: Delivery Rider
heroes.bio: Marco has delivered through rain, snow, and one small tornado. He was pulled through the rift mid-wheelie and still asked who ordered the pad thai.
heroes.fact: A greyhound can reach around 70 kilometres an hour within a few strides.
lines: A delivery rider! Did he bring snacks?
Marco. Delivers anything, anywhere. Even across time, apparently.
Marco! Two thousand years late. Tip him anyway, you cheap ass.

heroes.name: Maya Washington
heroes.title: Paramedic
heroes.bio: Maya has seen everything and is still nice about it. She arrived with a full trauma kit and immediately started checking everyone's pulse, including the book's.
heroes.fact: Golden retrievers were bred in Scotland in the 1800s to fetch shot birds out of the water.
lines: A paramedic! We're safe now!
Maya. Paramedic. Finally someone useful.
A paramedic. Thank god. I've been bleeding emotionally for three hundred years.

heroes.name: Brokk
heroes.title: Ice Age Hunter
heroes.bio: Brokk hunted mammoth with a stick and bad eyesight. He considers the wheel a fad. He has discovered central heating and will not be leaving.
heroes.fact: Badger families dig setts that can stay in use for generations.
lines: A big strong hunter from the Ice Age!
Brokk. From the Ice Age. He's going to hate the thermostat.
Brokk has never seen a toilet and he's about to have the best day of his life.

heroes.name: Gaius Marcellus
heroes.title: Legionary
heroes.bio: Twenty years in the Ninth Legion and all he got was a bad knee and strong opinions about road quality. Marches everywhere. Even to the fridge.
heroes.fact: Bulldogs were bred for bull-baiting, which England banned in 1835.
lines: A Roman soldier! So shiny!
Gaius. Legionary. Has opinions about marching.
A Roman legionary. Don't mention Carthage. He gets fucking weird about Carthage.

heroes.name: Edith Crane
heroes.title: Engineer
heroes.bio: Edith built three bridges before breakfast and was told each time that a gentleman must have helped. She keeps a list of those gentlemen. The list is laminated now.
heroes.fact: A beaver's front teeth never stop growing, and they are orange because of the iron in them.
lines: An engineer! She can fix the ledger!
Edith. Victorian engineer. Already judging our wiring.
Edith built bridges in the 1880s and she's looking at our setup like it's a crime scene.

heroes.name: Doctor Albrecht
heroes.title: Plague Doctor
heroes.bio: His cure for everything is leeches, and his cure for leeches is more leeches. Somehow his patients keep improving, mostly out of spite.
heroes.fact: Crows can recognise individual human faces and hold a grudge for years.
lines: A doctor with a bird mask! Spooky but cool!
A plague doctor. Wash your hands. Seriously.
A plague doctor from 1348. Everybody back the fuck up.

heroes.name: Vincenzo Moretti
heroes.title: Gangster
heroes.bio: Runs a perfectly legitimate olive oil business that has never sold a single olive. Extremely polite. That is the scary part.
heroes.fact: The least weasel is the smallest meat-eating mammal in the world.
lines: A fancy man in a nice suit!
Vincenzo Moretti. Don't ask what he does. Don't.
Vincenzo. Chicago, 1927. If anyone asks, we never saw shit.

heroes.name: Will Slapton
heroes.title: Leading Man
heroes.bio: Four-time winner of awards he gave himself. One slap away from greatness at all times. Does his own stunts, then describes them to you for an hour.
heroes.fact: Only the males are peacocks. The females are peahens, and together they are peafowl.
lines: A movie star! Can I have an autograph?
Will Slapton. Leading man. Bigger ego than the book.
Will fucking Slapton. Somebody hide the ledger before he slaps it.

heroes.name: Napoleon Bone-apart
heroes.title: Emperor
heroes.bio: Conquered most of Europe and still cannot reach the top shelf. Will invade any country that mentions it. Do not bring up Russia, winter, or stepladders.
heroes.fact: Corgis were bred to herd cattle by nipping at their heels.
lines: A tiny emperor! Look at his little hat!
Napoleon. Conquered Europe. Defeated by a kitchen counter.
It's Napoleon. He's two feet tall and he will absolutely fuck up your whole continent.

heroes.name: Cleocatra
heroes.title: Queen of the Nile
heroes.bio: Ruler of Egypt, seducer of empires, knocker of priceless vases off tables. Has not walked anywhere in years. Expects to be carried and will stare at you until it happens.
heroes.fact: Ancient Egyptians mummified cats in huge numbers.
lines: A queen! A real queen! Should I bow?
Cleocatra. She's already decided you work for her.
Cleocatra. She fucked up two Roman generals' whole lives and she'll do yours for fun.

heroes.name: Captain Blackbear
heroes.title: Pirate Captain
heroes.bio: The most feared captain on the seven seas, with smoking fuses in his beard and a ship full of stolen rum. Terrified of seagulls. The crew has agreed never to discuss it.
heroes.fact: Black bears are not always black. Some are brown, cinnamon, blond or even white.
lines: A pirate captain! With a real beard!
Captain Blackbear. Scourge of the seas. Scared of birds.
Blackbear. He'll gut you for a doubloon and cry if a seagull looks at him.

heroes.name: Astrid Ironhowl
heroes.title: Shield-Maiden
heroes.bio: Raided six kingdoms before she was twenty and was bored by five of them. Undefeated in battle. Has been looking for a comfortable chair for eleven hundred years.
heroes.fact: A wolf's howl can carry for several kilometres.
lines: A wolf warrior! She's so strong!
Astrid. Shield-maiden. Could bench-press the book.
Astrid could snap me in half and honestly? I'd fucking thank her.

heroes.name: Kenji Shibata
heroes.title: Ronin
heroes.bio: A masterless samurai bound by honor, discipline, and a ferocious loyalty to whoever is currently holding a rice ball. Sits when told. Does not roll over. He has standards.
heroes.fact: The Shiba Inu is one of Japan's oldest dog breeds, and it nearly died out in the 1940s.
lines: A samurai puppy! Such a serious face!
Kenji. Ronin. Loyal to no master. Loyal to all snacks.
Kenji will die for his honor. He'll also sell you out for one goddamn dumpling.

heroes.name: General Emu
heroes.title: Undefeated Commander
heroes.bio: In 1932 the Australian army went to war against emus with machine guns. The army lost. This is him. He has never lost a war and he would like you to know that.
heroes.fact: In 1932 Australia sent soldiers with machine guns to deal with emus. The emus won.
lines: A big bird general! He looks so proud!
General Emu. Beat an actual army. With his legs.
This bird beat the Australian fucking army. Machine guns and all. Salute him.

heroes.name: Frau Troffea
heroes.title: The Dancing Plague
heroes.bio: One July morning in 1518 she stepped into the street and started dancing. Four hundred people joined in. Nobody knows why. She is still going, and she is not tired.
heroes.fact: Hares are born with fur and open eyes, ready to run. Rabbits are born bald and blind.
lines: She's dancing! She's so good at dancing!
Frau Troffea. Started dancing in 1518. Hasn't stopped. Don't make eye contact.
She's been dancing for five hundred years. Do NOT let her grab your fucking hand.

heroes.name: Joost van der Bloem
heroes.title: Tulip Speculator
heroes.bio: At the peak of tulip mania Joost traded his house, his boat and two cows for a single bulb. The market crashed on a Tuesday. He ate the bulb on Wednesday. Still bullish.
heroes.fact: A hamster's cheek pouches stretch all the way back to its shoulders.
lines: He has a flower! He really loves his flower!
Joost. Traded his house for a tulip. It's a long story. It's a sad story.
This idiot swapped a whole fucking house for one flower. And he'd do it again.

heroes.name: Chad Hodler
heroes.title: Crypto Visionary
heroes.bio: Chad got in early on nine different coins and out early on none. He calls every cliff a dip. He is not giving financial advice, but he is giving it loudly.
heroes.fact: Lemmings do not march off cliffs together. That one is a myth.
lines: He says we're all going to the moon! Fun!
Chad. Lost everything twice. Calls it 'building'.
Chad's down ninety percent and still calling everybody else poor. Fucking legend.

heroes.name: Bella Pawsworth
heroes.title: Influencer
heroes.bio: Four million followers, three brand deals, one leg. Bella has been holding the same pose since 2019 and no longer remembers what the other foot was for. Link in bio.
heroes.fact: Flamingos hatch grey. The pink comes from what they eat.
lines: She's so glamorous! And so pink!
Bella. Four million followers. Zero idea where she is right now.
Bella's hot, she knows it, and she's already filmed you without asking. Smile, dipshit.

heroes.name: Florida Man
heroes.title: Local Legend
heroes.bio: Arrested for wrestling himself in a gas station car park. Released because nobody could work out which one of him started it. Every headline you have ever read. All him.
heroes.fact: The temperature of the nest decides whether alligator eggs hatch male or female.
lines: A big smiley alligator! With muscles!
Florida Man. Yes, that one. All of them, actually.
Florida Man. Shirtless, lawless, and one bad idea away from the fucking evening news.

heroes.name: Lola Vixen
heroes.title: Cabaret Star
heroes.bio: The brightest star of the Paris cabaret. Gentlemen came from across Europe to watch her dance, and went home without their watches, wallets, and in one case a small yacht.
heroes.fact: A fox can hear a mouse moving under deep snow, and pounces on it from above.
lines: A dancer! With feathers! So fancy!
Lola Vixen. Steals hearts. And, separately, wallets.
Lola. She'll blow you a kiss with one hand and take your goddamn wallet with the other.

heroes.name: Morwenna Duskwing
heroes.title: Hedge Witch
heroes.bio: Dark, brooding, mistress of forbidden arts. Lives alone in a cottage of bones and candle smoke. Completely unable to resist a lamp. It has ruined several curses.
heroes.fact: There are roughly ten times as many kinds of moth as there are butterflies.
lines: A witch! A pretty moth witch!
Morwenna. Very dark. Very mysterious. Keeps flying into the lantern.
Morwenna's a scary goth witch right up until someone turns on a fucking light.

heroes.name: Sable Quickpaw
heroes.title: Master Thief
heroes.bio: The finest thief in Venice. Has robbed the Doge three times and returned twice to rinse the loot in the canal. Leaves no fingerprints. Leaves everything slightly damp.
heroes.fact: A raccoon's front paws are so sensitive it can tell what something is by touch alone.
lines: A sneaky raccoon! Look at his little mask!
Sable. Master thief. Washes everything he steals. Everything.
Sable'll rob you blind and then wash your shit in a canal. Weird little bastard.

heroes.name: Jacko Riley
heroes.title: Surf Lifeguard
heroes.bio: Has pulled three hundred swimmers out of the surf and reminded every single one about sunscreen. Never skips leg day. Has never needed to.
heroes.fact: Kangaroos can barely move backwards. Their tail and big feet get in the way.
lines: A lifeguard! He'll keep us safe!
Jacko. Lifeguard. Abs you could grate cheese on.
Jacko's shredded, he's shirtless, and he just called me 'mate'. I'm fucking done.

heroes.name: Raspawtin
heroes.title: Unkillable Mystic
heroes.bio: They poisoned his cakes. He asked for seconds. They shot him, twice. He complimented the aim. They threw him in a frozen river and he was seen the next morning ordering brunch. Nobody has tried since. It seems rude.
heroes.fact: The borzoi was bred by Russian nobles to hunt wolves.
lines: A very tall dog with very intense eyes! Hello!
Raspawtin. Poisoned, shot, drowned. Still here. Deeply annoying.
They poisoned him, shot him and drowned him and the creepy fucker STILL showed up. Hide.

heroes.name: Mad Jack Ramsbottom
heroes.title: Officer and Lunatic
heroes.bio: Went to the Second World War carrying a longbow, a broadsword and a set of bagpipes, and used all three. When the war ended he was reportedly furious. Says any officer who goes into action without his sword is improperly dressed.
heroes.fact: Bighorn rams crash heads at around 30 kilometres an hour, and do it again.
lines: A soldier with bagpipes! And a sword! And a bow!
Mad Jack. Brought a sword to a tank fight. Won.
This lunatic charged a fucking beach playing the bagpipes. With a SWORD. And it WORKED.

heroes.name: Vesper Nightshade
heroes.title: Queen of the Batcave
heroes.bio: She has not smiled since 1979 and considers that a personal best. Knows every doorman in Soho, owns eleven black dresses that are all different, and will dance only if nobody is watching.
heroes.fact: Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly. Everything else is gliding.
lines: She looks sad! Shall we give her a biscuit?
Vesper Nightshade. Finds your enthusiasm exhausting.
Vesper. She'd haunt you, but honestly you're not worth the fucking eyeliner.

heroes.name: Roxy Riot
heroes.title: Three Chords and a Grudge
heroes.bio: Bass player in a band that has had four names and two gigs. The stripe is natural, the attitude is practised, and the amplifier is technically borrowed.
heroes.fact: A skunk can hit a target about three metres away, and warns you first by stamping its feet.
lines: Her hair is so tall! And stripy!
Roxy Riot. Plays bass badly, loudly, and on purpose.
Roxy. Can't play a note and doesn't give a single shit. Neither will you by the second song.

heroes.name: Jazzmin Sweat
heroes.title: Feel the Burn
heroes.bio: Host of a morning workout show watched by nine million people, six of whom exercise. Has never been tired, sad or still. Doctors would like to study her.
heroes.fact: Poodles were bred as water retrievers. The famous haircut was to keep joints warm in cold water.
lines: She's so bouncy! And five, six, seven, eight!
Jazzmin Sweat. Will make you do one more. Then one more.
Jazzmin. Smiles like that because she knows you're about to cry in a fucking leotard.

heroes.name: Captain Stella Comet
heroes.title: Ace of the Rocket Patrol
heroes.bio: Star of forty-one Saturday serials, each ending with her about to be eaten, melted or married to a Martian. She escaped every time, usually by flipping a switch marked ESCAPE.
heroes.fact: Snow leopards cannot roar. They chuff, growl and yowl instead.
lines: A space lady! Her hat is a fishbowl!
Captain Stella Comet. Saves the galaxy weekly. Matinee at two.
Stella. Forty-one death traps and the worst thing she ever met was the goddamn studio accountant.

heroes.name: Pixel Pam
heroes.title: Three Letters, Top of Every Board
heroes.bio: Holds the high score on every cabinet in the arcade, including the broken one. Lives on vending machine crisps. Her initials are PAM and you will never get rid of them.
heroes.fact: The red panda was called a panda about forty years before the giant panda got the name.
lines: She is very good at the beepy games!
Pixel Pam. Has one more quarter than you, always.
Pam. Beat a grown man so badly at a video game he sold his fucking car.

heroes.name: Gorm the Mighty
heroes.title: Master of the Immediate Area
heroes.bio: Came with a sword, a shield and a mail-in offer. Rules everything he can see, which without his glasses is about four feet. Shouts his own name before doing anything, including sitting down.
heroes.fact: A bison weighs close to a tonne and can still run at about 55 kilometres an hour.
lines: He is VERY big and VERY shouty!
Gorm the Mighty. By the power of whatever is nearest.
Gorm. All muscle, no shirt, and a sword he can't fucking lift above his own neck.

heroes.name: Commander Flap
heroes.title: The Bird Who Finally Flew
heroes.bio: Spent thirty years watching other birds do it. Then he found a rocket, two straps and a helmet, and has not been seen below two hundred feet since. Landing remains a work in progress.
heroes.fact: Emperor penguins can dive deeper than 500 metres and hold their breath for over twenty minutes.
lines: A flying penguin! He did it! Hooray!
Commander Flap. Up is easy. Down is where the paperwork starts.
Flap. Strapped a bomb to his back out of pure spite and it fucking worked.

heroes.name: Sgt. Max Carnage
heroes.title: One-Rhino Army
heroes.bio: Retired nine times. Each time somebody kidnapped a relative, a president or his boat. Carries a weapon nobody could lift and a one-liner for every occasion, most of them about the weather.
heroes.fact: A rhino's horn is made of keratin, the same stuff as your fingernails.
lines: He has a headband! He must be sporty!
Sgt. Max Carnage. Came out of retirement for this. Again.
Max. Walks away from explosions real slow because he's got a bad fucking knee.

heroes.name: Rex Sizzle
heroes.title: Voice of a Generation, He Says
heroes.bio: Frontman of a band whose biggest hit is a ballad about his own hair. Uses more hairspray in a week than a small town. Has been on a farewell tour since the second album.
heroes.fact: The Afghan hound is a sighthound: it hunts by spotting prey and outrunning it, not by scent.
lines: His hair is so shiny! Like a pony!
Rex Sizzle. Three octaves, two chords, one mirror.
Rex. The hair's real, the leather's fake and the fucking ballad is nine minutes long.

heroes.name: El Ajolote Dorado
heroes.title: The Golden One
heroes.bio: Undefeated in nine hundred bouts and has never once removed the mask, including at his own wedding. Fights crime on weekdays, wrestles on Sundays, and sleeps in a fish tank.
heroes.fact: An axolotl can regrow a lost limb, and keeps its feathery baby gills for its whole life.
lines: A shiny wrestling man! With frilly ears!
El Ajolote Dorado. The mask stays on. Do not ask.
El Ajolote. Lose an arm in the ring and the bastard just grows another one.

heroes.name: Doug from Accounts
heroes.title: Expense Auditor
heroes.bio: Doug has rejected your expenses. Not yours in particular: everyone's, since 2019. He was summoned halfway through a spreadsheet and has asked twice whether the ledger has been reconciled. It has not. He is fine with that. He is fine with everything. That is the unsettling part.
heroes.fact: The capybara is the largest rodent alive, and can stay underwater for up to five minutes.
lines: A capybara in a lanyard! He looks so calm!
Doug. Accounts. He will need a receipt for that.
It's Doug from fucking Accounts. Calmest bastard alive. He's already denied your lunch.

heroes.name: Bjorn the Twice-Dead
heroes.title: Ice Fisherman
heroes.bio: Bjorn has fallen through the ice twice and been declared dead both times. Both times he walked back into the village in time for supper. The gods keep sending him home and he has stopped asking why. He fishes. He waits. He is owed two funeral feasts and intends to collect.
heroes.fact: A walrus's tusks are teeth that never stop growing, and it uses them to haul itself out onto the ice.
lines: A big walrus with a fishing pole! So whiskery!
Bjorn. Died twice. Bad at it.
Bjorn drowned twice and Valhalla sent the fat bastard back both times. Even the gods didn't want him.

heroes.name: Mona Lisard
heroes.title: Portrait Painter
heroes.bio: The most sought-after portrait painter in Venice, and no two clients agree on what she looks like. She turns the colour of whatever she stands beside, which is usually your valuables. Her sitters get a lovely painting. Later, they notice the room is emptier.
heroes.fact: A chameleon's eyes move separately, so it can look in two directions at once.
lines: A lizard with a paintbrush! She changed colour!
Mona Lisard. Paints you. Then blends in with your silverware.
Mona'll paint your portrait and rob you blind in the same sitting, the sneaky little shit. Count the spoons.

heroes.name: Dusty Belle
heroes.title: Gold Prospector
heroes.bio: Dusty has been digging the same claim for eleven years and has found, in total, one nugget and a great many opinions. She watched the army lose a war to some birds from her front step and did not get up. She has a pickaxe, a grudge, and no intention of sharing either.
heroes.fact: Echidnas and the platypus are the only mammals that lay eggs.
lines: A spiky digger with a pickaxe! Careful, pointy!
Dusty Belle. Eleven years, one nugget, no patience.
Dusty's been digging that hole eleven fucking years. Do not ask her how it's going.

heroes.name: Inspector Hootsworth
heroes.title: Consulting Detective
heroes.bio: The Inspector solves every case the same way: she stares at the suspect, in silence, without blinking, until they confess. It has never taken longer than four minutes. She can turn her head to look directly behind her and does so at dinner parties, which is why she is no longer invited.
heroes.fact: An owl cannot move its eyes in their sockets, so it turns its head instead, up to 270 degrees.
lines: An owl detective! She has a tiny hat!
Inspector Hootsworth. She already knows what you did.
Hootsworth just stares at you till you fucking confess. I told her about the biscuits. I told her EVERYTHING.

heroes.name: Agent Sterling Stoat
heroes.title: Gentleman Spy
heroes.bio: Nobody knows who Sterling works for, including, by now, Sterling. He has infiltrated every speakeasy in Chicago and filed a detailed report on the cocktails. His white dinner jacket has never had a mark on it, which in his line of work is either great skill or a very bad sign.
heroes.fact: In cold places a stoat's coat turns pure white for winter. The white fur is called ermine.
lines: A fancy weasel in a white suit! So smooth!
Agent Stoat. Licensed to mingle.
Slick little bastard's been 'undercover' in a bar for six years. On expenses. Doug is furious.

heroes.name: Dolly LaRue
heroes.title: Canteen Sweetheart
heroes.bio: Dolly sang at the servicemen's canteen every night of the war, and every man in the room was certain she was singing to him. She was singing to the back wall, where the clock was. She has had forty-one proposals, kept all the rings, and now runs a very successful jeweller's.
heroes.fact: Reindeer are the only deer in which the females grow antlers too.
lines: A singing deer! She has a flower in her hair!
Dolly LaRue. Forty-one proposals. Kept every ring.
Dolly'll wink at you, take your ring and your whole damn paycheck, and you'll thank her. I did.

heroes.name: Gladius Maximus
heroes.title: People's Champion
heroes.bio: Undefeated in the arena, mainly because his opponents get distracted. Gladius has not worn a shirt since boyhood and oils his mane before every bout. He owns a sword and has rarely needed it. He simply flexes at the crowd until the other man gives up and asks for an autograph.
heroes.fact: A lion's roar can be heard from five miles away.
lines: A big strong lion! Look at his fluffy mane!
Gladius Maximus. Undefeated. Mostly by posing.
Shirtless prick oils his mane for an hour and wins by flexing. I hate how well it fucking works.

heroes.name: Dr. Quackenstein
heroes.title: Galvanic Physician
heroes.bio: The Doctor is certain that enough lightning can fix anything: a cold, a broken heart, death. He has been struck fourteen times while proving it and has called every one 'promising'. The villagers gave up on torches years ago. Now they leave soup at the gate and back away.
heroes.fact: A duck can sleep with one eye open and half its brain awake.
lines: A duck doctor with a lightning stick! Zap!
Dr. Quackenstein. Fourteen lightning strikes. Learned nothing.
Mad fucking duck's been hit by lightning fourteen times and thinks it's GOING WELL. Do not shake his hand.

heroes.name: Selene Nightbloom
heroes.title: Jewel Thief
heroes.bio: Every noble house in Venice has been robbed by Selene, and every one of them has since invited her to dinner, hoping to learn how. She arrives through the front door, in velvet, and leaves through a window nobody knew could open. She has never been caught. She has occasionally been bored.
heroes.fact: A black panther is not its own species. It is a leopard or jaguar with a dark coat, and the spots are still there in the right light.
lines: A sleek black cat lady! She moves so quietly!
Selene Nightbloom. Your vault called. It's empty.
Selene could steal the ring off your goddamn finger while shaking your hand. She did. Check.

heroes.name: Unit B33-P
heroes.title: Butler, Slightly On Fire
heroes.bio: A household robot from a future that has not happened yet, summoned halfway through serving tea. Unit B33-P is unfailingly polite, extremely well read, and has been slightly on fire since it arrived. It has raised this several times. Everyone agrees something should be done.
heroes.fact: The word 'robot' comes from a 1920 Czech play, and is taken from 'robota', meaning forced labour.
lines: A robot butler! Oh no, is that smoke?
Unit B33-P. Polite. Helpful. Mildly ablaze.
The robot's on fucking fire and it keeps APOLOGISING. Somebody get a bucket. It's been a week.

heroes.name: Pharaoh Tutankhamoose
heroes.title: Boy King, Wrong Continent
heroes.bio: Nobody in Egypt had ever seen a moose, so they assumed he was a god and gave him the throne. He was nine. He has gone along with it ever since, because the food is excellent. His antlers do not fit through any door in the palace. The doors have been rebuilt. Twice.
heroes.fact: A moose sheds its antlers every winter and grows a whole new set by the end of summer.
lines: A moose king with golden antlers! So shiny!
Pharaoh Tutankhamoose. Divine ruler. Does not fit through doors.
They saw a moose, panicked, and made him a fucking GOD. He's nine feet wide. Nobody's told him.

heroes.name: President Baldwin Eagleton
heroes.title: Candidate for Everything
heroes.bio: Baldwin Eagleton has been running for president for as long as anyone can remember, of nowhere in particular, against nobody. He has never held office and has given the victory speech nine times. He promises a fish in every pot and has no idea how pots work. His approval rating is, by his own count, tremendous.
heroes.fact: The fierce scream you hear from eagles in films is usually a red-tailed hawk. A real bald eagle makes a high, chirping whistle.
lines: An eagle in a suit! He's waving at everybody!
President Eagleton. President of what? Don't ask him.
Pompous feathered windbag's president of jack shit and he will NOT stop shaking my hand.

heroes.name: Zorp, Destroyer of Tuesdays
heroes.title: Definitely a Human
heroes.bio: Zorp came to conquer Earth, landed on a Tuesday, and found it so disappointing that he swore to destroy Tuesdays specifically. He wears a trench coat and a hat and insists he is a normal human man named Greg. He is three feet tall and grey. Everyone has agreed, quietly, to play along.
heroes.fact: In 1977 a radio telescope in Ohio picked up a 72-second signal from space so strong that the astronomer wrote 'Wow!' on the printout. Nobody has explained it for certain.
lines: A little grey person in a big coat! Hello, Greg!
Zorp. Says he's Greg. He is not Greg.
That's a fucking ALIEN in a trench coat and we're all just calling him Greg?? Fine. Hi, Greg.

places.name: The Archive
places.blurb: A cellar of unread books and one that reads back. Every name Smudge stamps pulls a stranger out of history.

places.name: Roman Dock
places.blurb: A quiet pier on the Tiber. Everything Rome ever dropped drifts past here sooner or later.

places.name: Bondi Rock Pool
places.blurb: Sun, salt, and a tide that keeps handing back whatever the tourists lost.

places.name: Lofoten Ice Hole
places.blurb: A hole cut through fjord ice. The cod are huge, the cold is worse, and something down there has antlers.

places.name: Speakeasy Safe
places.blurb: Five pins between Smudge and somebody else's money. The jazz upstairs covers the clicking.

places.name: The Doge's Vault
places.blurb: The richest strongbox in Venice. The lock was made by a genius. The guard was hired by a nephew.

places.name: The Supply Closet
places.blurb: The hardest lock in history. Only Brenda from Facilities has the key, and Brenda is on leave.

places.name: Emu War Trench
places.blurb: An abandoned trench from the only war ever lost to birds. The army left in a hurry. The emus kept score.

places.name: Witch's Clearing
places.blurb: Things are buried here that should stay buried. Smudge has a shovel and no sense of self-preservation.

kevin_weapon.name: Passive-Aggressive Stapler
kevin_weapon.flavor: Property of Kevin. Do not touch. He will know.

kevin_armor.name: Lanyard of Mild Authority
kevin_armor.flavor: Opens one door. The wrong one.

kevin_trinket.name: Bottomless Mug
kevin_trinket.flavor: It has never been washed. It has never been empty.

marco_armor.name: Thermal Delivery Bag
marco_armor.flavor: Keeps hot things hot and cold things someone else's problem.

marco_trinket.name: Five-Star Rating
marco_trinket.flavor: He earned every one. Then a guy named Greg gave him a three.

maya_weapon.name: Trauma Shears
maya_weapon.flavor: Cuts through denim, seatbelts, and excuses.

maya_armor.name: High-Vis Jacket
maya_armor.flavor: Visible from space. Comforting from up close.

maya_trinket.name: Lucky Stethoscope
maya_trinket.flavor: She listens. That's the whole secret.

brokk_weapon.name: Mammoth-Tusk Spear
brokk_weapon.flavor: Pointy end goes in the mammoth. Brokk wrote the manual. In grunts.

brokk_armor.name: Sabertooth Pelt
brokk_armor.flavor: Warm, stylish, and the previous owner put up a fight.

brokk_trinket.name: First Fire
brokk_trinket.flavor: He found it. He's very proud. Do not blow on it.

gaius_armor.name: Scutum Shield
gaius_armor.flavor: Has stopped arrows, spears, and one very angry goose.

gaius_trinket.name: Legion Eagle Pin
gaius_trinket.flavor: Lose it and the whole legion never speaks to you again.

edith_armor.name: Riveted Work Apron
edith_armor.flavor: Fourteen pockets. She knows what is in every one.

edith_trinket.name: Pocket Blueprint
edith_trinket.flavor: A plan for everything. Including you.

albrecht_weapon.name: Leech Jar
albrecht_weapon.flavor: For medicinal use. And for throwing.

albrecht_armor.name: Waxed Long Coat
albrecht_armor.flavor: Nothing sticks to it. He has tested this extensively.

vincenzo_weapon.name: Violin Case
vincenzo_weapon.flavor: He does not play the violin.

vincenzo_armor.name: Pinstripe Suit
vincenzo_armor.flavor: Tailored to hide exactly two things.

vincenzo_trinket.name: Lucky Silver Dollar
vincenzo_trinket.flavor: Heads, he wins. Tails, you never flipped it.

slapton_weapon.name: The Golden Hand
slapton_weapon.flavor: Awarded for Outstanding Achievement in Open Palm.

slapton_trinket.name: Walk of Fame Star
slapton_trinket.flavor: He pried it up himself. It was not his star.

napoleon_weapon.name: Saber of Austerlitz
napoleon_weapon.flavor: Very long. Compensating for nothing, he insists.

napoleon_armor.name: Bicorne Hat
napoleon_armor.flavor: Adds four inches. He counts them.

napoleon_trinket.name: Imperial Stepladder
napoleon_trinket.flavor: The real power behind the throne.

cleocatra_armor.name: Collar of Isis
cleocatra_armor.flavor: Heavy enough to explain why she refuses to walk.

cleocatra_trinket.name: Royal Milk Bath
cleocatra_trinket.flavor: Seven hundred donkeys were involved. Do not ask.

blackbear_weapon.name: Boarding Cutlass
blackbear_weapon.flavor: Eleven notches. Ten ships and one seagull that had it coming.

blackbear_armor.name: Captain's Greatcoat
blackbear_armor.flavor: Smells of rum, gunpowder, and poor decisions.

blackbear_trinket.name: Smoking Beard Fuse
blackbear_trinket.flavor: Intimidating. Also a fire hazard. Mostly a fire hazard.

astrid_trinket.name: Mead Horn
astrid_trinket.flavor: Victory tastes like honey and somebody else's village.

kenji_weapon.name: Katana 'Good Boy'
kenji_weapon.flavor: The blade's true name is known only to him. It's 'Good Boy'.

kenji_armor.name: Straw Travel Hat
kenji_armor.flavor: Hides his eyes. And his ears going flat.

kenji_trinket.name: Honorable Rice Ball
kenji_trinket.flavor: He would never eat it. He is going to eat it.

emu_weapon.name: Captured Lewis Gun
emu_weapon.flavor: Taken as a trophy. He has no idea how it works. Neither did they.

emu_armor.name: Outback Slouch Hat
emu_armor.flavor: The feather is his own. A power move.

troffea_weapon.name: Worn-Through Dancing Shoes
troffea_weapon.flavor: Pair number nine thousand and four.

troffea_armor.name: Whirling Skirt
troffea_armor.flavor: Stand back at least one skirt length.

troffea_trinket.name: Unstoppable Tambourine
troffea_trinket.flavor: It plays itself now. That's new.

joost_weapon.name: Pruning Knife
joost_weapon.flavor: For tulips, and for anyone who says 'bubble'.

joost_armor.name: Merchant's Ruff
joost_armor.flavor: The bigger the collar, the bigger the debt.

joost_trinket.name: Semper Augustus Bulb
joost_trinket.flavor: Worth one canal house. Or one lunch. Depends on the day.

chad_weapon.name: Laser Eyes
chad_weapon.flavor: Profile-picture grade. Not rated for actual combat.

chad_armor.name: Ape Hoodie
chad_armor.flavor: Bought at the top. Like everything else.

chad_trinket.name: Diamond Hands
chad_trinket.flavor: Cannot sell. Cannot hold a fork either.

bella_armor.name: Sponsored Bikini
bella_armor.flavor: Hashtag ad. Hashtag blessed. Hashtag armor, apparently.

bella_trinket.name: Verified Checkmark
bella_trinket.flavor: Proof that she is who she says she is. She isn't sure either.

florida_armor.name: Jorts of Power
florida_armor.flavor: No shirt. No shoes. No problem. No service.

florida_trinket.name: Lucky Scratch-Off
florida_trinket.flavor: Won forty dollars. Spent sixty celebrating.

lola_weapon.name: Ostrich Feather Fans
lola_weapon.flavor: Now you see her. Now you don't have a wallet.

lola_armor.name: Sequined Corset
lola_armor.flavor: Three thousand sequins. She sewed on none of them.

morwenna_weapon.name: Crooked Wand
morwenna_weapon.flavor: Bent that way on purpose. She says.

morwenna_armor.name: Cloak of Dusk
morwenna_armor.flavor: Looks like a shadow. Feels like a blanket.

morwenna_trinket.name: Suspiciously Warm Lantern
morwenna_trinket.flavor: She knows she shouldn't. She's going to.

sable_weapon.name: Stiletto Dagger
sable_weapon.flavor: Thin enough to open a lock. Or an argument.

sable_trinket.name: Skeleton Key Ring
sable_trinket.flavor: Forty keys. Thirty-nine doors. He's still looking for the last one.

jacko_weapon.name: Rescue Board
jacko_weapon.flavor: Saves lives. Also a pretty decent bat.

jacko_armor.name: Red-and-Yellow Cap
jacko_armor.flavor: Swim between the flags. He's serious.

jacko_trinket.name: Zinc Stripe
jacko_trinket.flavor: SPF one million. Smells like summer.

raspawtin_weapon.name: Suspicious Tea Cake
raspawtin_weapon.flavor: Laced with enough poison to stop an ox. He has eaten nine.

raspawtin_trinket.name: The Stare
raspawtin_trinket.flavor: You blinked first. Everyone blinks first.

madjack_weapon.name: Basket-Hilted Broadsword
madjack_weapon.flavor: The last sword drawn in anger in a modern war. He drew it a lot.

madjack_armor.name: Battle Bagpipes
madjack_armor.flavor: Enemy morale drops forty percent. So does everyone else's.

madjack_trinket.name: War Longbow
madjack_trinket.flavor: The only confirmed longbow kill of 1940. He would like that on record.

vesper_trinket.name: Ankh of Eternal Sighing
vesper_trinket.flavor: Symbol of eternal life. She finds the idea tiring.

vesper_weapon.name: Crimping Iron of Doom
vesper_weapon.flavor: Three hours a night. Hair like a startled crow.

vesper_armor.name: Fishnets (Third Pair Today)
vesper_armor.flavor: Ripped on purpose. The second rip was not.

roxy_weapon.name: Out-of-Tune Bass
roxy_weapon.flavor: Tuned once, in 1976, by somebody else.

roxy_armor.name: Tartan Bondage Trousers
roxy_armor.flavor: Forty zips. None of them do anything.

roxy_trinket.name: Safety Pin (Structural)
roxy_trinket.flavor: Remove it and the whole outfit falls off.

jazzmin_armor.name: Leg Warmers of Fury
jazzmin_armor.flavor: Her legs have never once been cold. Or stopped.

jazzmin_trinket.name: Signed Workout Tape
jazzmin_trinket.flavor: Volume six. Volumes one to five were also this.

stella_weapon.name: Atomic Ray Pistol
stella_weapon.flavor: Two settings: stun, and second take.

stella_armor.name: Bubble Helmet
stella_armor.flavor: Fogs up when she laughs. She tries not to.

stella_trinket.name: Rocket Patrol Badge
stella_trinket.flavor: Send in six box tops and you can have one too.

pam_weapon.name: Roll of Quarters
pam_weapon.flavor: Heavy in a sock. She has never needed the sock.

pam_armor.name: Satin Arcade Jacket
pam_armor.flavor: Won in a tournament. She was nine.

pam_trinket.name: Lucky Joystick Knob
pam_trinket.flavor: Unscrewed from the machine that started it all.

gorm_armor.name: Fur Trunks of Command
gorm_armor.flavor: The whole outfit. He owns two pairs.

gorm_trinket.name: Mail-In Power Amulet
gorm_trinket.flavor: Allow six to eight weeks for power.

flap_armor.name: Finned Flight Helmet
flap_armor.flavor: The fin is for steering. He thinks.

max_armor.name: Red Headband
max_armor.flavor: Tied on in slow motion, to music.

max_trinket.name: Dog Tags of a Fallen Buddy
max_trinket.flavor: His buddy is fine. He just left them at Max's house.

rex_weapon.name: Keytar of Destiny
rex_weapon.flavor: A piano you can wear. Nobody asked.

rex_armor.name: Leopard Spandex
rex_armor.flavor: Getting them on takes two roadies.

rex_trinket.name: Industrial Hairspray
rex_trinket.flavor: Keep away from the pyrotechnics. He does not.

ajolote_armor.name: The Golden Mask
ajolote_armor.flavor: He was born in it, according to him.

ajolote_weapon.name: Championship Belt
ajolote_weapon.flavor: Defended nine hundred times. Used as a weapon twice.

ajolote_trinket.name: Cape of Entrances
ajolote_trinket.flavor: Worn for nine seconds per match. Worth it.

doug_weapon.name: Red Pen of Rejection
doug_weapon.flavor: Three strokes and the words 'see me'.

doug_armor.name: Short-Sleeve Shirt, Tie Optional
doug_armor.flavor: Breathable. Unremarkable. Proof against small talk.

doug_trinket.name: Lanyard With Nine Keycards
doug_trinket.flavor: Only one of them opens anything. He knows which.

bjorn_weapon.name: Whalebone Ice Spear
bjorn_weapon.flavor: For the fish. And, once, for a very surprised bear.

bjorn_armor.name: Sealskin Coat, Still Damp
bjorn_armor.flavor: It has never fully dried. Neither has he.

bjorn_trinket.name: His Own Funeral Coin
bjorn_trinket.flavor: They left it on his eyes. He kept it. Seemed fair.

mona_armor.name: Paint-Stained Smock
mona_armor.flavor: Every colour she has ever been.

mona_trinket.name: The Unfinished Smile
mona_trinket.flavor: A small canvas. She says it is done. Everyone else has questions.

dusty_weapon.name: Old Faithful
dusty_weapon.flavor: A pickaxe. Named after the only thing that never let her down.

dusty_armor.name: Canvas Dungarees, Patched
dusty_armor.flavor: More patch than dungaree by now.

dusty_trinket.name: The One Nugget
dusty_trinket.flavor: She will not tell you where. She will not tell you how big.

hootsworth_weapon.name: Magnifying Glass, Large
hootsworth_weapon.flavor: She does not need it. It is for your benefit.

hootsworth_armor.name: Inverness Cape
hootsworth_armor.flavor: Wool. Rainproof. Conceals a remarkable wingspan.

sterling_armor.name: White Dinner Jacket
sterling_armor.flavor: Spotless. He will not say how.

sterling_trinket.name: Cufflink Camera
sterling_trinket.flavor: Forty exposures. Thirty-eight are of canapes.

dolly_trinket.name: Box of Forty-One Rings
dolly_trinket.flavor: She remembers every name. That is the cruel part.

gladius_weapon.name: Ceremonial Gladius
gladius_weapon.flavor: Still has the price tag. Never swung in anger.

gladius_armor.name: Single Shoulder Guard
gladius_armor.flavor: Covers one shoulder. The other is for the fans.

gladius_trinket.name: Flask of Mane Oil
gladius_trinket.flavor: Olive, with a hint of victory.

quack_weapon.name: Copper Lightning Rod
quack_weapon.flavor: Works every time. That is the problem.

quack_armor.name: Scorched Lab Coat
quack_armor.flavor: It was white once. So was he.

quack_trinket.name: Jar With Something In It
quack_trinket.flavor: It blinked. He says that is normal.

selene_weapon.name: Silk Grappling Line
selene_weapon.flavor: Holds a panther and a chandelier's worth of diamonds.

selene_armor.name: Midnight Velvet Catsuit
selene_armor.flavor: Makes no sound. Neither does she.

selene_trinket.name: The Doge's Signet
selene_trinket.flavor: He thinks it is in his vault. Bless him.

beep_weapon.name: Silver Serving Tray
beep_weapon.flavor: Deflects blades, arrows and unwanted guests.

beep_armor.name: Riveted Tailcoat Chassis
beep_armor.flavor: Rust-proof. Not, it turns out, fire-proof.

beep_trinket.name: Small Persistent Flame
beep_trinket.flavor: It has been raised at three meetings.

tut_weapon.name: Crook and Flail, Chewed
tut_weapon.flavor: Symbols of divine kingship. He thought they were snacks.

tut_armor.name: Gold Broad Collar
tut_armor.flavor: Forty pounds of gold. He has not noticed.

tut_trinket.name: Scarab of the Wrong Continent
tut_trinket.flavor: Carved in lapis. Shows, for some reason, a pine tree.

eagleton_weapon.name: Gavel of Order
eagleton_weapon.flavor: He bangs it to open meetings, close meetings and win arguments.

eagleton_trinket.name: 'I Voted For Me' Button
eagleton_trinket.flavor: The only confirmed vote so far.

zorp_weapon.name: Ray Gun Disguised as an Umbrella
zorp_weapon.flavor: It is not disguised well. It hums.

zorp_armor.name: Human Trench Coat, Adult Size
zorp_armor.flavor: Four feet too long. He calls it 'the fashion'.

zorp_trinket.name: Earth Calendar, Tuesdays Removed
zorp_trinket.flavor: Scorched out one by one. He is up to 2041.

e_kevin_weapon.name: Whiteboard Marker (Dry)
e_kevin_weapon.flavor: Squeaks. Leaves no mark. Still somehow threatening in a meeting.

e_kevin_head.name: Noise-Cancelling Headphones
e_kevin_head.flavor: Cancels noise, colleagues and three fire drills.

e_kevin_body.name: Fleece Vest of Middle Management
e_kevin_body.flavor: Grants the power to schedule a meeting about meetings.

e_kevin_feet.name: Sensible Loafers
e_kevin_feet.flavor: Have walked to the printer and back nine thousand times.

e_kevin_charm.name: Reply-All of Doom
e_kevin_charm.flavor: Four hundred people now know about the missing yoghurt.

e_marco_head.name: Cracked Bike Helmet
e_marco_head.flavor: It did its job once. It would like you to stop testing it.

e_marco_body.name: Hi-Vis Rain Poncho
e_marco_body.flavor: Visible from space. Still nobody yields.

e_marco_feet.name: Clip-In Cycling Shoes
e_marco_feet.flavor: You will fall over at a red light exactly once. Everyone does.

e_marco_charm.name: Phone at One Percent
e_marco_charm.flavor: It has been at one percent for six hours. Nobody understands how.

e_maya_weapon.name: Halligan Bar
e_maya_weapon.flavor: Opens doors, cars, and conversations nobody wanted to have.

e_maya_head.name: Scuffed Fire Helmet
e_maya_head.flavor: Smells of smoke and somebody else's kitchen.

e_maya_body.name: Turnout Coat
e_maya_body.flavor: Heavy, hot, and the only reason you still have eyebrows.

e_maya_feet.name: Steel-Toe Boots
e_maya_feet.flavor: You could drop a piano on these. Please do not.

e_maya_charm.name: Defibrillator Paddle of Enthusiasm
e_maya_charm.flavor: CLEAR. No, further back than that.

e_brokk_weapon.name: A Really Good Rock
e_brokk_weapon.flavor: The original weapon. Zero moving parts. Never jams.

e_brokk_head.name: Antler Headdress
e_brokk_head.flavor: Very impressive until you meet a doorway. Doorways have not been invented.

e_brokk_body.name: Woolly Mammoth Coat
e_brokk_body.flavor: The mammoth is no longer using it.

e_brokk_feet.name: Hide Foot Wraps
e_brokk_feet.flavor: Shoes, version one. Mostly a suggestion.

e_brokk_charm.name: Cave Painting of a Horse
e_brokk_charm.flavor: The first art critic said the legs were wrong. He was eaten.

e_gaius_weapon.name: Pilum Javelin
e_gaius_weapon.flavor: Designed to bend on impact so it cannot be thrown back. Rude.

e_gaius_head.name: Crested Galea Helmet
e_gaius_head.flavor: The crest is so the centurion can find you to shout at.

e_gaius_body.name: Lorica Segmentata
e_gaius_body.flavor: Forty-seven straps. One of them is always undone.

e_gaius_feet.name: Caligae Sandals
e_gaius_feet.flavor: Marched across a continent. Smell like it.

e_gaius_charm.name: Thumbs-Down of the Emperor
e_gaius_charm.flavor: Nobody is sure which way was bad. It worked out badly either way.

e_edith_weapon.name: Ball-Peen Hammer
e_edith_weapon.flavor: When it is your only tool, everything looks like a bridge.

e_edith_head.name: Brass Welding Goggles
e_edith_head.flavor: Make everything look like it is on fire. In her line of work, it usually is.

e_edith_body.name: Boiler Suit
e_edith_body.flavor: More pockets than sense. A spanner in every one.

e_edith_feet.name: Hobnail Boots
e_edith_feet.flavor: Announce your arrival two streets away.

e_edith_charm.name: Perpetual Motion Machine (Broken)
e_edith_charm.flavor: Ran forever, for about a minute.

e_albrecht_weapon.name: Pointing Stick
e_albrecht_weapon.flavor: For examining patients from a distance he considers reasonable.

e_albrecht_head.name: Beaked Mask
e_albrecht_head.flavor: Stuffed with lavender. Solves nothing. Smells lovely.

e_albrecht_body.name: Burial Shroud (Unused)
e_albrecht_body.flavor: Still in the wrapping. He is saving it.

e_albrecht_feet.name: Mud-Caked Clogs
e_albrecht_feet.flavor: The mud is the cleanest thing in the village.

e_albrecht_charm.name: Jar of Bad Air
e_albrecht_charm.flavor: Medieval science at its finest. Do not open. Do not ask.

e_vincenzo_weapon.name: Baseball Bat (Negotiating)
e_vincenzo_weapon.flavor: He has never played baseball. He has had many conversations.

e_vincenzo_head.name: Flat Cap
e_vincenzo_head.flavor: Worn low. Sees nothing. Heard nothing.

e_vincenzo_body.name: Trench Coat With Too Many Pockets
e_vincenzo_body.flavor: Watches? Cutlery? A second, smaller coat?

e_vincenzo_feet.name: Two-Tone Spats
e_vincenzo_feet.flavor: For leaving a room quickly but with style.

e_vincenzo_charm.name: Cement Sample
e_vincenzo_charm.flavor: A gift from a business associate. It is a hint.

e_slapton_weapon.name: Clapperboard
e_slapton_weapon.flavor: Take forty-seven. He will get it this time.

e_slapton_head.name: Director's Megaphone
e_slapton_head.flavor: Not a hat. He wears it as a hat.

e_slapton_body.name: Dressing Gown With His Own Face On
e_slapton_body.flavor: Monogrammed, embroidered, and for sale in the lobby.

e_slapton_feet.name: Tap Shoes
e_slapton_feet.flavor: He cannot tap. The shoes do not know that.

e_napoleon_weapon.name: Field Cannon (Pocket)
e_napoleon_weapon.flavor: Small, loud, and with a great deal to prove.

e_napoleon_head.name: Bearskin Cap
e_napoleon_head.flavor: Adds a full foot of height. He owns nine.

e_napoleon_body.name: Grenadier Greatcoat
e_napoleon_body.flavor: Marched to Moscow. Regretted it around Smolensk.

e_napoleon_feet.name: Riding Boots With Lifts
e_napoleon_feet.flavor: The lifts are a state secret.

e_napoleon_charm.name: Map With Everything Circled
e_napoleon_charm.flavor: He circled Russia twice. Nobody stopped him.

e_cleocatra_weapon.name: Crook and Flail
e_cleocatra_weapon.flavor: One is for guiding. One is for the other thing.

e_cleocatra_head.name: Vulture Crown
e_cleocatra_head.flavor: The vulture is decorative. She says.

e_cleocatra_body.name: Linen Robe of Nine Pleats
e_cleocatra_body.flavor: Ironed by forty servants. Sat on by one cat.

e_cleocatra_feet.name: Papyrus Sandals
e_cleocatra_feet.flavor: Have never touched the floor. That is what the litter is for.

e_cleocatra_charm.name: Cursed Cat Statue
e_cleocatra_charm.flavor: It is on the shelf. It was on the table. Nobody moved it.

e_blackbear_weapon.name: Flintlock With a Bent Barrel
e_blackbear_weapon.flavor: Shoots around corners. Not on purpose.

e_blackbear_head.name: Tricorne With a Parrot-Shaped Stain
e_blackbear_head.flavor: The parrot is gone. The memory remains.

e_blackbear_charm.name: Treasure Map Where X Is Everywhere
e_blackbear_charm.flavor: He drew it himself after the rum. All of them are worth checking.

e_astrid_weapon.name: Seax Knife
e_astrid_weapon.flavor: For bread, rope, and settling disputes about bread.

e_astrid_head.name: Helmet (No Horns, Actually)
e_astrid_head.flavor: Historians were very insistent about this.

e_astrid_body.name: Ring Mail Byrnie
e_astrid_body.flavor: Ten thousand rings. She counted on a slow raid.

e_astrid_feet.name: Fur-Lined Boots
e_astrid_feet.flavor: Warm, quiet, and soaked with someone else's river.

e_astrid_charm.name: Rune Stone That Says "Wet Paint"

j_blackforest_1.name: Acorn

j_blackforest_4.name: Crooked Spoon

j_blackforest_5.name: Witch's Shopping List

j_blackforest_6.name: Gingerbread Roof Tile

j_blackforest_7.name: Wolf's Dentures
